name: Konno Tomoko
source:
Leader of the three. She has glasses.

She is like a serious committee chairperson turned into an adult. She is good at making plans and and act neatly.

She is not very good at sex, but she is very knowledgeable and a quick learner.  She is well-proportioned. The main character is attracted to her because she resembles his first love.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/maniax/work/=/product_id/RJ047567.html/?locale=ja_JP]DLsite[/url]]
